areas.name: Route and Edition Setup
areas.location_cue: Steam, the title menu, an unused save slot, and the Raid Mode lobby.
areas.note: Windows HD is the catalogued primary route; later-console additions are isolated in their own area.

levels.1: The selected release contains the expanded home-platform Raid Mode.
levels.2: Install Resident Evil Revelations through Steam and apply every available update.
levels.3: Launch the game, create a clean local profile, open Campaign and Raid Mode once, then confirm Infernal difficulty and the expanded Raid roster can appear on this installation.

levels.1: Scanner use and evasive movement need dependable inputs.
levels.2: Test aiming, scanning, dodging, quick turns, weapon changes, and menu navigation before recording progress.
levels.3: Enter the opening campaign section, verify the Genesis overlay detects nearby objects, perform a quick turn and an evade, change weapons, then confirm prompts and HUD remain fully visible at the chosen resolution.

levels.1: The complete PC inventory includes optional store content.
levels.2: Install both part sets, three weapon packs, and two Raid character add-ons from Steam.
levels.3: Open Steam's DLC manager, enable all seven products, let the game update, then inspect Raid character selection and the store or weapon inventory for the added entries before beginning the completion audit.

levels.1: Some long-term records are easier to verify with a stable partner connection.
levels.2: Create a private Raid lobby and confirm another current Steam player can join.
levels.3: Host Stage 01 on Chasm, invite the partner, finish the stage, and verify both profiles receive a saved result. Treat connection failure as a service issue, not as campaign incompletion.

levels.1: Several counters and one-run conditions benefit from a recovery point.
levels.2: Back up the local profile before beginning campaign and Raid completion.
levels.3: Close the game completely, copy the current Steam userdata save through an approved local backup method, relaunch, and verify the profile loads before accumulating clears, scans, and Raid bonuses.

areas.name: Final Completion Audit
areas.location_cue: Campaign records, the green weapon crate, Raid stage tiles, inventories, and profile display.
areas.note: Perform this audit only after the campaign, Raid, DLC, and route-specific sections above are complete.

levels.1: The campaign menus expose every lasting clear and collection record.
levels.2: Confirm three difficulty clears, five clear marks, 33 files, 30 handprints, and 16 enemy scans.
levels.3: Review the clear records and main-menu marks, then compare the file, handprint, and research tallies against 33, 30, and 16. Reopen any numbered entry whose count is short and finish its section again.

levels.1: Permanent weapons, parts, and capacities live in separate inventory views.
levels.2: Confirm 13 campaign weapons, 42 named custom parts, and all five maximum ammunition capacities.
levels.3: Open a green weapon crate on the completed save, count all 13 listed firearms and 42 distinct part names, then inspect inventory limits for 400 handgun, 300 shotgun, 700 machine-gun, 300 rifle, and 200 magnum rounds.

levels.1: Stage tiles and name color reveal missing grades and bonuses.
levels.2: Confirm 60 regular S ranks, the bonus-stage clear, all 244 bonuses, and player level 50.
levels.3: Inspect every Chasm, Trench, and Abyss tile for S and four lit emblems, inspect the bonus stage for its four emblems, verify the profile name is purple, and confirm the level display reads 50.

levels.1: Characters, rare weapons, menu marks, and DLC occupy different screens.
levels.2: Confirm 22 listed appearances, four super-rare weapons, three tier marks, and every DLC component.
levels.3: Cycle all identity-neutral character and costume slots, verify Pale Rider, High Roller, Drake, and Muramasa, count three regular-tier main-menu marks, then audit 15 DLC weapons, 58 DLC parts, and two DLC character slots.

levels.1: The primary PC save cannot display later-console additions.
levels.2: Record separate clears for The Ghost Ship: Chaos and Switch-only Ghost Ship Panic when pursuing franchise-wide content.
